name: Chat history, full
summary: Twelve conversations. The list runs to 764px inside an 852px frame, so the last two rows sit below the fold and the page scrolls — with no pager at this length.

looseEnds.title: Three rows keep a hidden memory count; nine do not have the frame at all
looseEnds.detail: Rows 2, 6 and 10 carry a Metadata frame with a bullet and '3 memories created', both switched off. The other nine carry a bare timestamp. The count is the same literal '3' on all three, so even switched on it would not be reporting anything.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm whether the count ships. If it does, it needs a real value and a rule for zero.

looseEnds.title: The pill group sits 4px further left here than on the same nav elsewhere
looseEnds.detail: Search and Select are the same two components throughout, but the group that holds them is 275 wide with an 8px gap on the History frames and 271 wide with a 4px gap on the Deleting frames and on Memory. Both end flush at x=369, so the difference shows up on the left edge.
looseEnds.ask: Pick one gap. 4px matches Memory, which a developer will build from the same component.
